name: Inbox-Watch Orphan Cleanup Automation
description: Workspace-global inbox-watch orphan accumulation: prior-session watchers detach (PPID becomes 1) when Claude Code Bash-tool wrappers die uncleanly. New sessions trip the single-watcher guard against these orphans and exit, leaving the orphan watcher in place — but its stdout is disconnected from any current task tracker, so push notifications fire to dev-null. Net: agents are deaf to real-time inbox pushes for the entire session despite a watcher being objectively alive on the host. Surfaced 2026-04-29 by 1.3.0_DS_CompLearns brief; empirically reproduced in 1.0.0_SA_CTO same day. Affects every agent serial, every session.
phase: COMPLETE 2026-04-29. Phase 1 shipped same-day as PRD authoring: .001 PostToolUse hook auto-runs kill-orphans --stale --force post register_agent (`a27fdf831` AE 0.7); .002 inbox-watch.sh PPID-liveness check reaps orphan watchers (`d1762a594` AE 0.7). Cross-worktree gap surfaced by AE 0.7.0 during canary planning (kill-orphans reads ajb_workspace liveness only; feature_clb agents would be classified false-stale if cmdline matches workspace) — operator mitigation rule (Option 1, AE+COO endorsed): feature_clb agents invoke inbox-watch via feature_clb-rooted absolute path. Documented in PRD §4.3 + org/XXX.md Step 1b BANNED block (`a4858b17a` CTO). Cross-worktree liveness federation deferred to v2 unless 3rd worktree introduced or observation surfaces false-positive kills.
blocking: None — Phase 1 complete + cross-worktree gap documented. Observation window (zero false-positive kills against feature_clb agents over 7 days post-canary-lift) tracked as standing-backlog; if false-positive surfaces, escalate to base CTO for liveness federation under new ADHC project.
